mechanism.claim: When the funding-rate first difference reverses sign after the prior settlement in a causally high-variation cycle, an elevated new impulse identifies a change in leverage-demand direction that persists over the next settlement cycle.
mechanism.why_distinct: Unlike HVFADR and HVCFDR, this policy requires two consecutive funding first differences with exactly opposite signs and follows the new impulse; it has no price/funding divergence or onset rule and does not fade the current shock.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: actual funding-settlement first-difference shocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.previous_settlement: immediately prior actual settlement P with S-P exactly 8 elapsed hours
features.prior_settlement: settlement Q immediately before P with P-Q exactly 8 elapsed hours
features.impulse_reversal: strict sign(funding_rate[S]-funding_rate[P]) equals negative strict sign(funding_rate[P]-funding_rate[Q])
features.change_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute funding_change over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [P,S))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: both exact eight-hour gaps, both finite nonzero changes, exact opposite signs, and both ranks pass at S; no divergence, onset, funding-level, OI, premium, alt, or post-settlement condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: signal settlement precedes entry; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no settlement gap, previous-change, sign-reversal, history, rank, side, variation, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
